title: chore(changeset): declare the delete_package tool-name widening of #31037 as minor / added
body:

_Requested by **田騏** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSi?thread=cmsg_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSi5J6nJimd74SxqQG1aJ98pr)_

Fixes #31471

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: added

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：只改一个尚未发版的 changeset（`.changeset/cloud-3656-spec-delete-package-tool-name.md`）的三行申报：`@objectstack/spec` 从 patch 改为 minor，`Clause-②` 从 no 改为 yes (widening)，`Metadata-protocol` 从 none 改为 added。正文不动，不改任何代码。
- **为什么改**：#31037 把 `delete_package` 加进平台工具名登记表后，技能的 `tools[]` 写 `delete_package` 从「被 lint 报为虚构工具」变成「通过」，这是一次放宽，却按 patch 申报；下次发版的版本号和发版说明会因此写错。同一登记表此前的 `read_package_doc`、`draft_record` 都按 minor / added 申报。
- **风险与回滚**：无运行时变化，只影响下次发版 `@objectstack/spec` 升 minor 而非 patch、以及发版说明的分类；回滚即还原本 PR。
- **先看**：`.changeset/cloud-3656-spec-delete-package-tool-name.md` 的 frontmatter 和两行申报。
- **两分钟验证**：`node scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs --base origin/main` 应退出 0；`check-empty-changeset` 会按设计红（改了别人的待发 note），这是本 PR 申报的 DELIBERATE CORRECTION。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

One pending changeset, three declaration lines. The body sentence is unchanged.

```diff
-'@objectstack/spec': patch
+'@objectstack/spec': minor
-Clause-②: no
-Metadata-protocol: none
+Clause-②: yes (widening)
+Metadata-protocol: added
```

## Why

#31037 added `delete_package` to `PLATFORM_TOOLS_BY_PACKAGE['service-ai-studio']`, so `PLATFORM_PROVIDED_TOOL_NAMES` carries it. A skill whose `tools[]` names `delete_package` was refused by the ADR-0109 reference-integrity lint before and is accepted now: one more accepted `skill.tools[]` value, which is a widening of what a metadata author can write (`Metadata-protocol: added`, at least `minor` per AGENTS.md Post-Task Checklist item 3). The same registry's earlier additions were declared this way: `packages/spec/CHANGELOG.md` entries 0fb0dda (`read_package_doc`, `search_package_docs`) and 99a6a78 (`draft_record`).

## DELIBERATE CORRECTION

This PR rewrites a pending release note it did not add: `.changeset/cloud-3656-spec-delete-package-tool-name.md` (from #31037). It is unconsumed on `main`, so the correction reaches the next release. `check-empty-changeset` refuses a foreign changeset edit and stays red by design; restoring the note from the base would put the false declaration back. The corrected sentences, before → after:

- `'@objectstack/spec': patch` → `'@objectstack/spec': minor`
- `Clause-②: no` → `Clause-②: yes (widening)`
- `Metadata-protocol: none` → `Metadata-protocol: added`

The prose paragraph (`The cloud build agent gains a delete_package tool …`) is byte-identical. The dispatching seat confirms this by its ACCEPT (text-only diff).

## Verification

Every command `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derives for this diff, run after `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`, at head on base `7d0b47ca`:

<details><summary>19 commands: 18 exit 0, 1 designed red</summary>

```
node scripts/check-adr-0087-registration.mjs --base origin/main :: exit 0
node scripts/check-adr-0087-registration.mjs --self-test :: exit 0
node scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs --base origin/main :: exit 0
node scripts/check-closing-keyword-parity.mjs :: exit 0
node scripts/check-closing-keyword-parity.mjs --self-test :: exit 0
node scripts/check-comment-mask-corpus.mjs :: exit 0
node scripts/check-empty-changeset.mjs --base origin/main :: exit 1   (DELIBERATE CORRECTION, designed red)
node scripts/check-empty-changeset.mjs --self-test :: exit 0
node scripts/ci/snapshot-next.mjs --self-test :: exit 0
node scripts/pm/release-rehearsal-clone.mjs --self-test :: exit 0
node scripts/release-pending-publish.mjs --self-test :: exit 0
```

No package source is touched, so there is nothing for `pnpm lint` or `pnpm test` to judge. No Fable review: the order rules this a declaration-only changeset correction that the seat checks in its ACCEPT.
